_meta.description: Seed dataset for the Digital Manufacturing Resource Load & Capacity Tool, v1.7 data model. BAU is represented as demand items of type BAU (no separate bau_streams/bau_allocations). Phases can be finite (hours_by_month) or indefinite (steady_state_hours, end_month null). Requirements are skill-shaped with allocations attached. Statuses follow the v1.6 state machine.
